The '''Separatist commando blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by the [[Nimbus commando]]s during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The weapon was capable of both long-range [[Sniper|sniping]] and semiautomatic rapid fire as well as of launching concussive sonic blasts.<ref name="GaW" />
